Join us for this exclusive event

Join us for an enchanting afternoon of wine exploration at our Wine Tasting - Bordeaux event! Immerse yourself in the rich heritage and exquisite flavors of one of the world’s most celebrated wine regions.

From 3:30 pm, we invite wine enthusiasts and novices alike to gather at our winery for a delightful experience that will transport you straight to the sun-drenched vineyards of Bordeaux, France.

As you sip on a carefully curated selection of Bordeaux wines, ranging from the robust reds of the Left Bank to the elegant whites of the Right Bank, our expert sommelier will guide you through the unique characteristics and stories behind each bottle. Learn about the renowned grape varieties, the art of blending, and the influence of terroir that make Bordeaux wines so exceptional.

The afternoon will feature:

  • A tasting of eight exquisite Bordeaux wines, including iconic châteaux and hidden gems.
  • Pairing of artisanal cheeses and gourmet bites that complement the wines perfectly.
  • Engaging discussions and insights into the history and culture of Bordeaux winemaking.
  • A chance to mingle with fellow wine lovers and share your own experiences.

Whether you’re a seasoned connoisseur or just beginning your wine journey, Wine Tasting - Bordeaux promises to be an unforgettable afternoon filled with flavor, knowledge, and camaraderie.

Reserve your spot today and raise a glass to the timeless elegance of Bordeaux!

We look forward to sharing this exquisite experience with you! Cheers!
The workshops take place in the evening, on weekdays, in our premises specially dedicated to active learning around vines and wine.

Join us for this brand new class!

Unlock the secrets of wine with our comprehensive 6-month Oenology class! Designed for both beginners and enthusiasts, this immersive program will take you on a journey through the fascinating world of wine production, tasting, and appreciation.

Course Highlights

  • In-Depth Curriculum: Explore the science of viticulture, fermentation processes, and the art of blending. Each module is crafted to provide a thorough understanding of the wine-making journey from grape to glass.
  • Hands-On Experience: Participate in practical workshops, vineyard visits, and tastings that will enhance your sensory skills and deepen your appreciation for different wine styles and regions.
  • Expert Instructors: Learn from seasoned professionals in the field, including winemakers, sommeliers, and viticulturists, who will share their knowledge and passion for wine.
  • Networking Opportunities: Connect with fellow wine lovers and industry professionals, expanding your network and enhancing your learning experience.

Who Should Enroll

This class is perfect for anyone interested in wine, whether you’re a novice looking to learn the basics or a seasoned enthusiast wanting to deepen your knowledge. No prior experience is necessary!

Don’t miss this opportunity to elevate your wine knowledge and skills! Secure your spot today and embark on a flavorful journey through the world of oenology. Cheers to your wine education!

Discover Burgundy beyond the famous names.

An evening to discover Burgundy from a different angle. Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, village appellations and winemakers' cuvées: our team offers a selection of bottles chosen for their personality and their connection to the terroir. A friendly tasting, open to curious beginners and seasoned wine lovers alike.

Our Tasting Room

What should you drink with Comté? Which wine works best with goat cheese? And why does blue cheese love sweet wines?

Taste your way through a selection of wines and cheeses and discover how acidity, tannins, texture and salt influence the perfect pairing.

Meet the person behind the bottle.

Join us for an intimate evening with a passionate winemaker who will share the story of their estate, their vineyards and their approach to winemaking. The evening will finish with a tasting of six wines from the estate.
Around the world in six glasses

Six wines. Six countries. One unforgettable journey.

Travel from France to Italy, Spain, Portugal, South Africa and Argentina through a selection of distinctive wines. A fun and accessible tasting for curious beginners and experienced wine lovers alike.
The art of food & wine pairing

An evening dedicated to the art of pairing wine and food.

Enjoy a five-course dinner accompanied by five carefully selected wines. Throughout the evening, our wine experts will explain what makes each pairing work — from acidity and texture to aromas and balance.
30+ wines · Winemakers · Food pairing · Free-flow tasting

Our biggest wine evening of the year.

Meet passionate winemakers, discover more than 30 wines, taste rare bottles and explore new favorites in a relaxed and festive atmosphere. Enjoy great wine, small bites and plenty of opportunities to talk with producers and fellow wine lovers.
